prompt.label: SQL query generation
prompt.description: Generates SQL query by user description in a natural language.

command.label: Execute prompt
command.description: Execute quary in human language by using AI translator

function.name: List catalog names
function.description: Lists catalogs/databases available in the current datasource. 'Catalog' is the same as 'database' in many database servers.
function.userDescription: Lists catalog/database names available in the current datasource

function.name: List schema names
function.description: Lists schemas available in the current datasource or catalog/database.

parameter.name: catalogName
parameter.description: Name of catalog/database containing schemas. Leave empty if catalog is not known or not supported by server.

function.name: List table names
function.description: Returns a list of tables available in the current datasource. Call it also to verify whether a table exists.

parameter.name: catalogName
parameter.description: Catalog or database name. Leave empty if catalog is not known.

parameter.name: schemaNames
parameter.description: Comma-separated schema names. Use short name without preceding catalog name. Required if the database supports schemas (take the default schema from the context if unknown). Leave empty only if the database has no schemas.

function.name: Get table details
function.description: Returns detailed information (columns, constraints, etc) about a specific tables as a DDL. Pass all needed tables in tableNames, do not call it separately for each table. Additional ddl parameters are disabled by default as they may slow down DDL extraction. To ensure that a certain tables exist call tool 'db_listTableNames'.

parameter.name: tableNames
parameter.description: Comma-separated list of fully qualified table names (with preceding catalog or/and schema names)

parameter.name: ddlConstraints
parameter.description: Adds constrains (primary keys, foreign keys) in the DDL. Default: false.

parameter.name: ddlIndexes
parameter.description: Adds indexes and other storage information in the DDL. Default: false.

parameter.name: ddlComments
parameter.description: Adds table and column comments in the DDL. Default: false.

parameter.name: ddlReferences
parameter.description: Adds foreign keys from other referencing tables in the DDL. Default: false.

function.name: Get Datasource Info
function.description: Returns information about the current datasource: its type, version, and other relevant details.

function.name: Execute DQL
function.description: Executes read-only SELECT-like SQL queries and returns the results in the specified format. Use executeDML for data changes and executeDDL for schema changes.

parameter.name: catalogName
parameter.description: Catalog name to execute the query in. Must be specified if the database supports multiple catalogs.

parameter.name: sqlQuery
parameter.description: Read-only SELECT-like SQL query. Use fully qualified table names.

parameter.name: maxRows
parameter.description: Maximum number of rows to return

function.name: Execute DML
function.description: Executes data manipulation statements, including INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, and CALL. Returns the number of modified rows reported by the driver, or -1 if unavailable. All referenced database objects must be in the allowed scope.

parameter.name: catalogName
parameter.description: Catalog name to execute the statements in. Must be specified if the database supports multiple catalogs.

parameter.name: sqlQuery
parameter.description: DML statements to execute. Use fully qualified table names.

function.name: Execute DDL
function.description: Executes data definition statements, including CREATE, ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE, RENAME, and COMMENT. Existing objects and the parent namespace of new objects must be in the allowed scope. Routine and trigger definitions with opaque bodies require datasource-wide scope.

parameter.name: catalogName
parameter.description: Catalog name to execute the statements in. Must be specified if the database supports multiple catalogs.

parameter.name: sqlQuery
parameter.description: DDL statements to execute. Use fully qualified object names.

function.name: Execute DCL
function.description: Executes data control statements, including GRANT and REVOKE. Object privileges must be in the allowed scope; global privilege and role changes require datasource-wide scope.

parameter.name: catalogName
parameter.description: Catalog name to execute the statements in. Must be specified if the database supports multiple catalogs.

parameter.name: sqlQuery
parameter.description: DCL statements to execute. Use fully qualified object names.
